Name: Francis of Assisi
Summary: Italian merchant's son who renounced wealth and founded the Friars Minor, living in radical poverty and preaching to ordinary people.
Contribution: The Franciscan order carried his vision of poverty, humility, care for lepers and the poor, and love of creation across Europe, and renewed preaching and pastoral care in towns.
Testimony: Hearing the gospel call to leave all and follow Christ, he stripped himself of wealth and lived as a poor brother among the poor.
